# Cultist spawns: All locations including map

![Cultist Spawns: All locations including map](/uploads/732_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

The Cultists are one of the most mysterious factions in *Fallout 76*. Their belief revolves around the Mothman, whom they worship as a divine being. Even before the Great War, a cult around the mysterious creature arose in the town of Point Pleasant. After the nuclear war, several fanatical groups developed that practice their religion with increasing devotion - and often with brutal violence.

Today the cultists can be found in many regions of Appalachia. They build shrines and camps in remote locations, perform rituals, and defend their sacred sites with fanatical zeal. Although they do not all share the same beliefs, they are united by their worship of the Mothman and the conviction that they serve a higher purpose. For players, the cultists are among the most distinctive enemies in *Fallout 76*, as they are clearly different from raiders or other factions and are deeply connected to the unique history of Appalachia.

![Cultists](/uploads/nukaknights-post-cultists-skywalka55-fallout76-20260705-12-35-33.jpg)

The **Lucky Hole Mine** plays a special role within the cultist lore. Deep beneath the mine is a secret shrine where cultists pay homage to a mysterious creature known by the community as the **Interloper**. Whether this is an ancient deity, a mutation or an entity related to the Mothman remains deliberately open. However, the numerous altars, offerings and occult symbols in the mine suggest that the Interloper has as much religious significance for at least some cultists as the Mothman himself. To this day, the Lucky Hole Mine is one of the most mysterious places in all of Appalachia and is a central part of the dark background story of *Fallout 76*.

![Interloper](/uploads/nukaknights-lucky-hole-interloper.jpg)

## Mothman eggs

In the places where the cultists are, they always set up Mothman altars. There you will find Mothman eggs, for example: for making brain bombs.
